mechanism: Tranylcypromine (MAOI) inhibits monoamine oxidase while tetrabenazine depletes monoamines; combined use risks severe hypertensive crisis, serotonin syndrome, and unpredictable CNS effects due to conflicting monoamine modulation.
action: Contraindicated combination; do not use together; ensure minimum 14-day washout of tranylcypromine before initiating tetrabenazine or vice versa.
